notes.19: Options A, C and D were equally popular incorrect answers. The reaction between an ammonium salt and a base produces ammonia, which is therefore W. When ammonia reacts with chlorine it gives an element X and an acidic gas Y. X must be nitrogen and Y must be hydrogen chloride. Y reacts with ammonia to give Z. Z is therefore ammonium chloride, hence the answer is B.
notes.22: Options A, B and C were equally popular incorrect answers. Since the monomer for PVC is chloroethene the repeat unit of PVC is (CH CHCl). Statement D is the only incorrect statement, so D is the correct answer.
notes.26: The most commonly chosen incorrect answer was C. 0.0075 moles of X burn to give 0.0300 moles of CO , so each molecule of X has four carbon atoms, leaving A and B as possible answers. B cannot be oxidised by acidified potassium dichromate(VI), so the correct answer is A.
